content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ESIC Lucknow Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Employees State Insurance Corporation Lucknow (ESIC Lucknow) for filling up 45 healthcare vacancies on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in ESIC Lucknow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available positions include Full Time/Part Time Specialists across various medical departments, Senior Residents, Ayurveda Physician, and Homeopathy Physician.

faq.question: Q3. How can I apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply through the Walk-in mode. There is no need for prior online registration; eligible applicants can directly appear for the walk-in interview with necessary documents.

faq.question: Q4. What is the date for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interviews are scheduled to be held on 12 October 2026 and 13 October 2026. Candidates must check the official notification for exact department-wise dates and reporting times.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for Specialists?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for Specialist posts must hold an MBBS degree with a PG Degree, PG Diploma, or DNB in the concerned specialty along with registration from NMC/MCI/SMC, or BDS with MDS for dental posts.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for Senior Resident candidates is 45 years, with age relaxations applicable to SC, ST, and OBC categories as per Central Government rules.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the interview?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates belonging to unreserved and other eligible categories are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 500/-, while SC, ST, PWD, ESIC, female, and ex-serviceman candidates are exempted.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry original certificates along with a set of self-attested photocopies of educational qualifications, experience certificates, ID proof, category certificates, and application form with DD if applicable.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary offered for Full Time Specialists?
faq.answer: Full Time Specialists receive a basic pay of Rs. 67,700/- per month plus Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), and other admissible allowances as per ESIC guidelines.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website for ESIC Lucknow?
faq.answer: Candidates can visit the official Employees State Insurance Corporation website at www.esic.gov.in to check detailed notifications, updates, and further announcements regarding the recruitment process.
